race.comment: RAINBOW CHARLIE (3) gets the nod on the strength of his Newcastle debut, where he was a well-supported favourite and finished third, beaten just over a length on heavy ground. His Gosford run before the break was poor, but his trial in readiness in the new colours suggest he's got things back on track. STEVIE'S SPIRIT (8) is a clear danger despite finishing rearward at Eagle Farm, but she raced wide in Saturday company and is eased back after being beaten a neck on debut at Ipswich. PRETTY PRETTY GOOD (2) holds plenty of intrigue on debut, shouldering a nice little price tag and being a full brother to Listed winner Regal Zeus. He was close enough in a recent Doomben trial to command respect with blinkers applied. A bright start won't surprise. POETIC BELLE (6) also holds genuine claims after running third here on debut last time and should be better for the race experience.
